cover.report_type: Seven days before a general election

_meta.notes: Cover form title '2024 Financial Disclosure Report For a Candidate' (the candidate variant of the 2024 form), filed 2024-10-29 for the 2024 cycle; index 'date' 2024-10-29 and candidate/office/seat confirmed at the page. index 'reporting_period' is the filer's email address (katie@votekatieolson.com) - flagged, not relabeled (audit note confirmed). 'Is this report an amendment?' Yes and No boxes BOTH unchecked - is_amendment recorded blank. Report Verification print name 'Katherine Olson'; cover candidate name 'Katie Olson'. Signature bar-redacted. p3/p12 are 'See attached' county stubs with blank subtotal/total cells; the filer's spreadsheet exports carry the detail (attachment-behind-stub both sides). Contribution attachment column C (Complete Mailing Address) is bar-redacted on every row and the sheet has no separate city/state/zip columns, so donor_city/donor_state are blank throughout. Occupation blank on 12 contribution rows where the filer left the cell empty (noted per row). 8 IN-KIND pairs mirror across the two schedules (6800.76 each side). p20-p22 are a wholly blank Other Campaign Accounts section. Several expenditure amounts print without $ or decimals (1000, 50, 700, 6602, 2000) or without $ (233.98, 370.67, 12.87, 7962.58, 643.5, 2628.83, 13.44) - transcribed verbatim with per-row notes. 'Manfacturing' (line 81) and lowercase 'actBlue' (E line 5) are filer typos kept verbatim.

contributions.detail: 126 rows (attachment rows 2-127) sum 24241.40 = Summary line 1 Column A; neither the attachment nor the county Schedule A stub prints any total (stub subtotal/total cells blank), so the Summary is the only anchor. Includes 8 IN-KIND rows totaling 6800.76.

expenditures.detail: 243 rows (attachment rows 2-244) sum 33864.21 = Summary line 2 Column A; no printed schedule total exists. Includes 8 IN-KIND rows totaling 6800.76 that mirror the Schedule A in-kind entries.

itemized.page_subtotal_gates: no printed page subtotals anywhere: county stubs p3/p12 have blank SUBTOTAL/TOTAL cells and the spreadsheet attachments print none; gated on Summary Column A per side instead (both exact)
